note: Round 1, against corpus-rust-vulns-txt (1,963 per-advisory text records flattened from the staged records.jsonl harvest: RustSec advisory-db 1,228 @3461c0d8 CC0-1.0 + crates.io OSV export 735 GHSA-sourced records RustSec did not take, zero alias overlap, CC0-1.0). The raw harvest is typed JSONL with no `text` field — issue #1158 invisibility class — so it was flattened before indexing, never burned. Queries blind-authored from the domain framing (an agent reviewing Rust crate dependencies for vulnerable versions, affected functions, fixed releases); expect clauses whitespace-normalised grep-verified unique against the built mirror before any retrieval. Coverage span: memory-corruption (smallvec, libpulse), TLS defaults (openssl), unsound/informational stratum (memoffset), and one OSV-sourced record (webauthn-rs) so both sources are exercised.
